title: GMC Jammu Recruitment 2026 - Project Technical Support-I (ICMR Project)
qualificationText: B.Sc / M.Sc in Radiography, MIT, MRIT or equivalent. Bachelor's route needs 1 year of experience; Master's route needs none.
salary: Rs 18,000 + 20% HRA = Rs 21,600 per month (Year 1 and 2)
shortInfo: GMC Jammu has invited applications for 1 temporary post of Project Technical Support-I under the ICMR-funded PRECISION-HPB project in the Department of Radio Diagnosis (Principal Investigator: Dr. Rajesh Sharma). The last date is 23 November 2026 up to 4:00 PM. Only residents of J&K can apply.
eligibilityNotes:
Bachelor's route: B.Sc. Radiography, BMRIT, B.Sc. MIT, B.Sc. (RT), BRIT or recognised equivalent in medical radiology / imaging technology, with at least 1 year of relevant work experience.
Master's route: M.Sc. Radiography, M.Sc. MRIT, M.Sc. MIT, MRIT or recognised equivalent. No post-bachelor experience needed.
Desirable: experience with medical imaging data, CT/MRI datasets, DICOM, clinical or biomedical research, MS Excel, and AI/ML in medical imaging.
Maximum age is 30 years, counted as on the last date of application.
Candidates must be residents of the UT of J&K.
The post is temporary and project-based, initially for one year. Extension depends on performance, project needs and funds. No right to regularisation.
Selected candidates must report within 7 days with original documents, sign a contract agreement and give an affidavit before a 1st Class Magistrate. One month's notice is needed to resign.
selection:
No written test or walk-in. If more than 10 eligible applications are received, candidates are shortlisted on academic performance, research and public health experience.
Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview and final selection is based on interview scores.
The interview date will be announced on the GMC Jammu website. No TA/DA is paid for attending.
howToApply:
Download the advertisement and application form from the GMC Jammu website (gmcjammu.nic.in)
Fill in the form completely and attach self-attested copies of all documents
Affix one passport photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer and attach one extra photograph
Submit by hand at the Office of the Principal, GMC Jammu, or email scanned copies to the address given in the notification
Last date: 23 November 2026, up to 4:00 PM (next working day if it falls on a holiday)
Applications with missing documents will be rejected. Phone: 0191-2584247
documents:
Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
Domicile certificate
Experience certificate from a competent authority
Matriculation or date-of-birth certificate
Updated CV / resume
Two passport-size photographs (one attested by a Gazetted Officer)
NOC or application through proper channel, if applicable

dates.event: Last date to apply (up to 4:00 PM)
